mechanisms.rationale: The canonical stage-event schema v1 module is the sole deliverable. It provides validateEvent, parseEventStream, emitEvent, CLI surface (--validate, --selftest, --json, --emit-event), and exported constants (SCHEMA_VERSION, VALID_STAGES, etc.). All exports serve one atomic contract: provide the canonical stage-event schema v1. The module is inert until invoked — zero npm dependencies, zero side effects on load, zero behavior change to any existing system. Downstream consumers (A2, A5, DIR-124-B) can import from this module without any other DIR-124 changes. The byte-identical mirror at plugin/scripts/ is a dependent artifact, not a separate mechanism (mirror-diff is an existing gate, not a new mechanism introduced by this child). The test file (workflow-event-schema.test.mjs) is validation, not a separately shippable mechanism.
